data.title: 毒蛇 · 街头依偎的双人自拍
data.description: 人流如织的购物街头，毒蛇双手紧紧挽住你的手臂，半个身子贴在怀里。她单手举起手机歪头眨眼比出剪刀手，甜美的大波浪卷发拂在你肩头，满脸幸福。
data.location: colorful trendy shopping avenue during the afternoon
data.action: clinging tightly to partner arm, pressing cheek close, holding up smartphone with cute peace sign and playful wink, bustling city background
data.lighting: bright modern urban daylight with colorful storefront reflections
data.mood: sweet romantic affection, adorable clingy girlfriend, youthful energy
data.promptProse: Clinging tightly to partner arm on a busy city avenue, Viper takes a selfie with her smartphone, winking cutely with a peace sign.
data.animaCaption: Viper clinging tightly to partner taking a cute smartphone selfie on a city street.
